headline: Found why none of these servers appears in VS Code's built-in MCP picker, and it is a property of our own registry entries rather than anything about the product.

vscode_gallery.surface: api.mcp.github.com, read by VS Code's MCP picker, syncs daily from the official registry, 252 servers
vscode_gallery.separator: 0 of 252 gallery entries have repository.subfolder; 19 of 100 sampled registry entries do; all 89 of ours do
vscode_gallery.experiment: com.bestremotetools/office-suite-all-servers-one-install published pointing at a standalone repo with no subfolder, same namespace as a subfolder entry so only the tested variable differs
vscode_gallery.watch: scripts/vscode-gallery-watch.mjs now records the subfolder ratio each run

docker.validated: all four CI steps run locally against a real Docker daemon: validate, build --tools, catalog, clean, plus go test
docker.verified: fresh clone, docker build --no-cache, then a real handshake under --network none returning 11 tools and four working tool calls
docker.blocker: fork PRs need a maintainer to approve the workflow run; no action available to us or the operator
docker.queue: VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY: main last moved 2026-08-21, 19 days ago, with 1,146 open pull requests. Do not spend another loop here until this one moves.

hosted_endpoints.defect: a browser asking for /mcp/<server> was handed raw JSON
hosted_endpoints.fix: content negotiation on accept: text/html; the protocol path is byte-identical and tools/call without a token still 401s
hosted_endpoints.verified: browser 200 text/html 4,298 bytes; no accept header 200 application/json; POST tools/list 200; POST tools/call 401

github_repo.was: description named 4 of 31 servers, 10 topics, README opened with text and no proof
github_repo.now: accurate description, 20 topics each a browsable GitHub page, README opens with a real demo and the two install paths that work

correction.claim: an earlier draft this loop said real people were arriving from Google search
correction.why_wrong: Search Console URL Inspection says those URLs are unknown to Google and have never been crawled, and several requests carry an HTML entity fused into the path, which no browser produces
correction.now: recorded as automated traffic of unknown origin; the fix stands on its own merits

coupling_found: remote/build-vendor.mjs patches about 113 exact strings including tool descriptions, so editing a description breaks the hosted build. Documented and added to the verification steps.

glama.indexing: Not steerable. 24 repo fields diffed between the indexed and unindexed mirrors and none discriminates. Glama's own methodology says there is no crawler for open-source servers, yet our record exists unclaimed. Lag is 33 minutes for one repo and about 120 days for another, which is a queue and not a filter.
glama.connectors: The real surface, and it is already working: the official registry is mirrored into glama.ai/mcp/connectors with no account, and our presence went from 4 to 25 servers between 09-07 and 09-09 with nobody doing anything. Connectors carry the identical scoring rubric and re-score daily.
glama.biggest_lever: license_activate was the minimum-scoring tool on 20 of 20 connectors at mean 2.26 and low 1.4, while license_status scored 4.12. It is registered ONCE in packages/mcp-license and inherited by all 31 servers, and 40 percent of the score is the minimum tool score, so one string capped the fleet. Rewritten to 202 characters, verified accurate against the code.
glama.defect_found_in_our_own_tool: The watch script used a badge returning 200 as the listing test. Glama serves a 2,880-byte placeholder badge for repositories that do not exist, byte-identical to one for a made-up repo, so the probe reported 3 of 33 when the true count is 1 of 33. Trusting it would have published a badge for a 404 page.

fixed: CI status not available: real workflow added, two green runs on the indexed mirror
No stable releases found: real tag and release v0.20.0
1 commit in 12 weeks: squashing removed, the mirror now has real history
repo_signals.ci_paid_for_itself: It immediately exposed two defects the mirrors had shipped silently: contract tests that read a sibling server's source a mirror never contains, affecting nine servers, and a timezone concurrency test that ran on the free tier because its key came from a skipped test.
repo_signals.resync_blocked: A sync builds from the working tree, and 21 servers currently carry uncommitted rebuilt edits while timezone fails its own tests. Syncing now would publish failing code to 31 public repos with a visible red badge. Guards added that refuse a dirty sync.

pre_existing_defect_found.what: license_status at 534 characters and license_activate at 674 were both over the estate's own 220 ceiling at HEAD
pre_existing_defect_found.scope: registered once and inherited by all 31 servers, so the description contract test was failing on every server before this loop
pre_existing_defect_found.how_found: checked HEAD in a separate git worktree rather than assuming the failures belonged to the agent editing descriptions

server_count_fix: SERVER_COUNT was 30 while 31 servers gate Pro, so every free-tier cap message and bundle link named a stale count. Fixed in both the licence package and the hosted shim.

tool_quality.scorer_validated: the agent's scorer reproduces Glama's published minimum of 2.9 on the one indexed server exactly
tool_quality.before: lowest server minimum 2.35; 0 of 31 servers had a minimum at or above 3.0
tool_quality.after: lowest server minimum 3.15; 31 of 31 at or above 3.0
tool_quality.target_missed_honestly: the brief asked for every minimum above 3.5 and 5 of 31 reach it. The binding constraint is the estate's own 220-character contract ceiling, which will not hold six scored dimensions at full marks. The ceiling was not raised and no name was added to the grandfathering baseline.
tool_quality.why_it_compounds: Glama scores 40 percent on the single worst tool, so the minimum is the whole game, and connectors re-score daily so this is measurable within a day

estate.deployed: hosted worker redeployed twice with the new descriptions

open_submissions.docker: PR 5030 open, queue stalled 19 days with 1,146 open PRs
